groups.title: Quality Diamond Polished Concrete Flooring
groups.summary: Texas Concrete Flooring is your choice for quality diamond polished and stained/ dyed concrete flooring in the state of Texas.
groups.intro: Texas Concrete Flooring is your choice for quality diamond polished and stained/ dyed concrete flooring in the state of Texas. We polish your concrete with the same tooling used to polish your typical granite or marble countertops. This eliminates the need for epoxies or topical sealers that you’ll find in your traditional stained & sealed concrete floors.

about.title: We promise floors that last for decades
text: Texas Concrete Flooring is a concrete contractor in Baytown, working on residential, commercial and industrial floors.
We put our clients' needs first and work to bring your vision to life, with materials and workmanship that give you a floor that lasts.
Our polished concrete is ground with the same tooling used on granite and marble countertops, so it needs no epoxy or topical sealer.
